tools.description: Query a Tag Provider with a bounded semantic subset of system.tag.query. Supports native continuation without exposing the internal UDT definition namespace.

continuation.description: Opaque continuation token returned by a previous tag_query call. When supplied, the Gateway-stored query is continued.

includeUdtMembers.description: Whether UDT members may appear. Default true.

maxResults.description: Maximum results in this page, 1..500. Default 100.

namePattern.description: Optional Tag name Like-pattern, for example *Pump*.

pathPattern.description: Optional Tag path pattern understood by system.tag.query, for example Area/*.

provider.description: Tag Provider name. Required for a new query; omit or leave empty when continuing with a continuation token.

returnProperties.description: Properties to return from the allowlist: path, name, tagType, dataType, valueSource, typeId, quality. path is always added internally.

tagType.description: Optional tag type: AtomicTag, Folder, or UdtInstance. UDT definitions are handled by udt_type_* tools.

valueSource.description: Optional value source: memory, opc, expr, db, reference, or derived.

tools.name: tag_query
tools.title: tag_query

tools.description: Read current Tag values via system.tag.readBlocking. Bad/Uncertain quality remains domain data, not Tool failure. Tag property/document sub-paths are rejected. Preserves request order and duplicate paths. D28 ignition-null-v1 encodes logical null as {"$ignition":"null"}; documents containing $ignition are escaped as {"$ignition":"object","entries":[[key,encodedValue],...]}. Arrays and objects recurse; see tag_read_output Resource schema. Example: {"tagPaths":["[System]Gateway/SystemName"]}.
tools.name: tag_read
tools.title: tag_read

tools.description: Execute one deployment-approved bounded Named Query alias. Arbitrary SQL, arbitrary Named Query paths, transactions, QueryString parameters, and dynamic datasource selection are not exposed.

offset.description: Dataset offset for aliases whose approved pagination mode is offset. Default 0.

pageSize.description: Dataset page size. 0 selects the registry default. Hard ceiling 2000. Ignored only for scalar aliases.

parameters.description: Validated Value-style parameters declared by the approved alias.

tools.name: database_query
tools.title: database_query

tools.description: Calculate validated Historian aggregates across the entire requested range. This is not a time-bucket API.

aggregates.description: At most 18 validated whole-range calculations before duplicate removal. Supported: Average, SimpleAverage, Sum, Minimum, Maximum, MinMax, LastValue, Range, Count, CountOn, CountOff, DurationOn, DurationOff, Variance, StdDev, PctGood, PctBad.

endTime.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to now.

paths.description: Historical paths. Hard maximum 100; each path is limited to 2048 characters.

startTime.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to 7 days before endTime.

tools.name: historian_query_aggregate
tools.title: historian_query_aggregate

tools.description: List current shelved Alarm Paths with expiration and shelving identity via system.alarm.getShelvedPaths.

maxResults.description: Maximum shelved paths, 1..500. Default 100; over-limit results fail rather than truncate.

tools.name: alarm_shelved_list
tools.title: alarm_shelved_list

tools.description: Return Runtime Bundle identity and current Gateway/MCP Module information.
tools.name: bundle_info
tools.title: bundle_info

tools.description: Browse historical paths with native bounded continuation. Patch-specific/ignored Historian parameters are intentionally not exposed.

continuation.description: Opaque continuation token returned by a previous historian_browse call; at most 8192 characters.

maxResults.description: Maximum results in one page, 1..500. Default 100.

nameFilters.description: Optional native name filters; at most 20 non-empty strings of at most 256 characters each.

recursive.description: Whether to browse recursively. Default false.

rootPath.description: Historical browse root such as a histprov-qualified path; at most 2048 characters.

tools.name: historian_browse
tools.title: historian_browse

tools.description: Read one bounded UDT type definition by provider-relative type path. Callers never provide the internal _types_ namespace.

typePath.description: Provider-relative UDT type path such as Motors/VFD. Do not include _types_.

tools.name: udt_type_get
tools.title: udt_type_get

tools.description: Read bounded Tag configuration with system.tag.getConfiguration. The internal UDT definition namespace is reserved for udt_type_* tools.

maxResults.description: Maximum configuration nodes after recursive expansion, 1..200. Default 50.

overridesOnly.description: For UDT members on supported Ignition versions, return only overridden properties. Default false.

path.description: Absolute provider-qualified Tag, Folder, or UDT instance path outside _types_.

recursive.description: Whether to include descendants. Default false.

tools.name: tag_get_config
tools.title: tag_get_config

tools.description: List UDT type definitions in one Tag Provider without exposing the internal _types_ namespace in the public contract.
tools.name: udt_type_list
tools.title: udt_type_list

tools.description: List only deployment-approved Named Query aliases. Backend project/path/datasource details are not caller-selectable.
tools.name: database_query_list
tools.title: database_query_list

tools.description: Query a finite bounded historical time series using system.historian.queryRawPoints. sampleCount must be positive; Natural/On-Change unbounded-style modes are forbidden.

endTime.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to now.

paths.description: Historical paths. Hard maximum 50; each path is limited to 2048 characters.

sampleCount.description: Finite positive sample count. Default 100. paths x sampleCount may not exceed 25,000.

startTime.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to 24 hours before endTime.

tools.name: historian_query_series
tools.title: historian_query_series

tools.description: Browse a bounded Tag hierarchy using system.tag.browse. UDT definition namespace _types_ is excluded. Results are never silently truncated: a partial bounded browse returns limit_exceeded.

path.description: Absolute provider-qualified Tag path such as [default]Folder or [System]Gateway.

recursive.description: Whether to recursively browse descendants. Default false.

tools.name: tag_browse
tools.title: tag_browse
